title: Disruption of ten protease genes in the filamentous fungus Aspergillus oryzae highly improves production of heterologous proteins
authors: Yoon J; Maruyama J; Kitamoto K
notes: P5, P7, P9 and P10 are the paper's names for strains carrying that many protease deletions, each built by adding deletions to the one before. All comparisons here are against P5, so only the deletions beyond P5 are listed as edits. The P5 controls carry the same five deletions as the P7-P10 lineage but are a different clone. Less chymosin was lost to degradation between days 4 and 5 as deletions accumulated: 22% (P5), 5% (P7), 1% (P9), 2.5% (P10). The 84.4 mg/L P5 control is the same measurement as YOON2009_004, not a new one.

CURATION BLOCKER: every A. oryzae value is normalized per total protein, so a vs_control here is a ratio of ratios and is not comparable to the mg/L fold changes elsewhere in this dataset.
